mapper.select: SELECT id, prompt_key, prompt_text, version, updated_by, created_at, updated_at FROM ai_prompt_config ORDER BY prompt_key
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_prompt_config (prompt_key, prompt_text, version, updated_by) VALUES (#{promptKey}, #{promptText}, 1, #{updatedBy}) ON CONFLICT (prompt_key) DO UPDATE SET prompt_text = EXCLUDED.prompt_text, version = ai_prompt_config.version + 1, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by, updated_at = now()
